formatted_question:
According to the opinion 'America First Legal Foundation v. Jamieson Greer', if AFL had alleged only that OSC denied it an investigation under section 1216, without tying that denial to any concrete interest, its alleged injury would amount for standing purposes to
(A) a substantive statutory entitlement to an investigation
(B) a procedural right in vacuo
(C) an injury in fact traceable to OSC's refusal to act
(D) a generalized grievance about agency enforcement
(E) a concrete informational injury
option_a: a substantive statutory entitlement to an investigation
option_c: an injury in fact traceable to OSC's refusal to act
option_d: a generalized grievance about agency enforcement
distractors: ["a concrete informational injury", "a generalized grievance about agency enforcement", "a substantive statutory entitlement to an investigation", "an injury in fact traceable to OSC's refusal to act"]
